note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is thin on the shards the datasets-server infers from: 1814 records carry only `{factory, generator, round}` while the 1018 records in rounds 78-586 add `kind`, `plant` and `sim_or_real`, so the inferred struct cannot cast the wider one and the parquet index never builds. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: a string on all 2832 records; never a list and never absent, so it is not optional here even though the worked example's `plan` is

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`bash` -> `command`; `read` -> `path`, plus `limit` / `offset` on two calls; `edit` -> `path`, `old`, `new`; `write` -> `path`, `contents`; `grep` -> `pattern`, `path`). No `args` value type varies across the 48350 calls

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 17436 of 48350 steps, spread over 1190 of 2832 records; no record carries it on every one of its steps

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `apply_fails`, `plan_changes` and `cost_steps` (int) on all 2832 records; `tests_passed` on 2804, `handoff` on 1418, `tests_failed` on 1388; plus `pods_ready` on 5, `rolled_back_to` and `cluster_ip_unchanged` on 2 each, and seven single-record keys (`dbi_resource_id_unchanged`, `allocation_ids_unchanged`, `dual_state_avoided`, `wrong_cluster_apply`, `wrong_chart_apply`, `replicas`, `targets_healthy`). 16 distinct key sets in all. `handoff` is the only key whose value type varies: int on 1405 records, string on 13

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on all 2832 records; the 1018 records in rounds 78-586 add `kind` (always `episode`), `plant` (509 distinct designed plants, two records each) and `sim_or_real` (always `designed`), while the 1814 records in rounds 1-77 and 587-1416 carry the thin three-key shape. This is the cast the viewer dies on

disclosures.summary: `reward.handoff` is an int on 1405 records but a string naming an owning team on 13. `reward.tests_passed` and `reward.tests_failed` do not vary: both are int wherever present. The listed ids are the only string-valued `handoff` records.

disclosures: Every one of the 2832 records is an `infra-as-code-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, and every id carries the `iac-` prefix. The leftover-object wording on 1372 ids and 2150 goals is this factory's own advertised mechanic - each round publishes a success episode paired with a leftover/handoff episode - and is naming, not a foreign payload dump.

disclosures.summary: There is no inbound leftover mill in this dataset: no record carries a foreign `meta.factory`, a foreign id prefix, a `factory_mix` marker, or a dest stamp. The dest-stamped and factory-mix mill classes are owned by the destination dumps that actually hold those records, not by this one.

disclosures: Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (48350 of 48350). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.

The 1416 published shards hold exactly two records each, ids are unique across the dataset, and every payload file is named `data/raw/batch-rNN.jsonl`, so the single declared glob covers the whole release.
